notes:
Summary: Montclair builds post-call synthesis and coaching layers for mid-size contact centers. Primary value prop is condensed QA notes + coachable highlights that map to scorecards and LMS. They need reliable summaries during spikes and near-real-time agent prompts.

POC ask: 2-week pilot ingesting 10k weekly calls (SIP->transcript), generate 1) short summary (1-2 bullets), 2) QA rubric mapping, 3) coaching highlights with timestamps, 4) suggested help docs / playbook links. Tool-calling: surface actions (create ticket, escalate, open KB) via function-calls to their orchestration API.

Constraints: PII in transcripts, strict retention policy for EU customers, preference for VPC/private control plane. Telephony scale: expect 400 concurrent streams during peak (holiday campaign), must not degrade summary latency > 1.5s for agent prompts. Cost sensitivity: moderate — willing to trade higher per-token cost for latency guarantees on agent-facing paths.

Security: SOC2 required, SSO/SAML, KMS for key management, audit logs for all inference calls, retention controls per customer. Legal wants a list of sub-processors and data residency assurance before contract.

Commercial: estimated ARR 75k-250k, procurement calendar targets Jan 2026. Competitive evaluation includes Observe.ai and Talkdesk; they cited "better offline QA and more deterministic fallbacks" as decision criteria.

Quote from head of ops on 2025-10-22 call: "We need coaching highlights that our supervisors can action in under 30s — noise-free, timestamped, and tied to our rubric."
